_comment: Stormwood homecoming. Live party names and canonical personal choices only; no stored roster or invented bond memory.

regional_homecoming_0.speaker: Grandpa Elias
lines: You're home. The Long Storm has quieted, and word reached us from the roads you reopened.
From these fields to the islands, the cliffs and the forest, people can find one another again.
Come sit a minute. I'm glad you're here.
